purpose: Teach: 信条/造成/受理/一元化/大前提/証書/共用/黙々と

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の信条、社員、心に、刻んで、業務に、当たれ、絶対だ。
lines.en: Our company's creed — carve it into your hearts and bring it to your work. Without question.
lines.style: Formal, measured cadence. Weight on the core principle. Each clause lands distinct. Authority without volume — the kind that comes from knowing you'll be listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新規宅地造成、地元自治体、許可、受理、いただきました、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We've received the local government's approval for the new residential development, sir.
lines.style: Respectful, clear reporting tone. Slight lift on the good news. Professional but genuine — the relief of a task completed well. Steady eye contact through the update.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 情報システム、一元化、進めろ、業務効率、絶対、上がる、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Push the information systems consolidation forward. Operational efficiency will improve — count on it.
lines.style: Directive, but not harsh. Confident in the instruction. Slight lean forward. Expects compliance, assumes competence. The tone of someone giving a task to someone who can handle it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。信頼関係、大前提として、社員、教育、徹底しております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We're treating trust as the foundation and training our staff thoroughly on that basis, sir.
lines.style: Earnest reporting, pride underneath the formality. Not defensive — confident in the work being done. Calm, steady delivery. The pause before 'sir' shows respect without servility.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業者の証書、社史館に、保管しろ、貴重な、財産だ、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Store the founder's certificate in the company museum. It's a precious asset — keep it safe.
lines.style: Formal directive with underlying care. The asset matters; the instruction is about preservation, not control. Slight warmth beneath the authority. Speaks it like it's a trust being handed down.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。共用スペース、社員、皆、丁寧に、使ってくれております、感謝、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The staff are using the shared spaces with care — we're grateful for that attention to detail, sir.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction in the observation. No performance, just noting something good. Warm but measured. The tone of someone who notices when people get things right.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新人、黙々と、業務、こなしてるな、本気、感じる、絶対、評価しろ、頼む。
lines.en: The new employee — working through tasks steadily and in earnest. I can feel the seriousness. Evaluate them fairly.
lines.style: Observational, thoughtful. Slight admiration underneath. Not a performance review — more like noticing real effort. Calm, reflective pace. Ends with the weight of a fair judgment being requested.
